create.name: Catherine Genno Pagès
create.bio:
Catherine Genno Pagès Roshi is a French Zen teacher who leads Dana Sangha, the lay practice centre she founded in 1994 in Montreuil, on the eastern edge of Paris. Born near Grenoble and raised in Paris, she studied art history and worked in galleries and museums before years of travel in the Americas and Asia brought her to Tibetan Buddhist practice. After returning home in 1982 she began studying with Dennis Genpo Merzel, an American Zen teacher, and trained with him in Europe and the United States for a decade and completed his koan curriculum, receiving dharma transmission in 1992 and final approval, inka, in 2005. Her line runs back through Taizan Maezumi Roshi, who founded the Los Angeles Zen Center, within the White Plum family that draws on both Soto and Rinzai Zen.

At Dana she offers silent sitting, shikantaza, alongside koan study, with morning and evening sittings through the week, roughly monthly sesshins of a long weekend or a week, and a two-week summer retreat in the French countryside. The community is made up of lay people who want to keep the old forms of Zen while living ordinary working lives. She has authorised seven dharma successors, among them Amy Hollowell in Paris, who now lead groups across Europe and in Thailand.

courses.title: Sesshins at Dana Sangha
courses.description: Intensive Zen retreats that she leads through the year at the Montreuil centre, lasting from a long weekend to a week, plus a two-week summer sesshin at a château in Burgundy. Places are limited and must be booked in advance; the next one listed runs 9 to 13 December 2026.

courses.title: Weekly Zen Meditation at Dana Sangha
courses.description: Regular zazen at the Montreuil centre on Tuesday to Friday mornings and on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday evenings, with teachings and private interviews from the centre's teachers. Beginners can book an introduction to sitting and walking meditation on a Thursday evening.

free_resources.title: Transmission Retreat – A Dharma Talk by Catherine Genno Pagès Roshi
free_resources.description: An hour-long talk she gave at a 2021 summer retreat in the Morvan, published on the Wild Flower Zen Sangha podcast. Free to stream.
